Parliament Monsoon Session Ends Amidst Disruption Blame Game

India's Parliament Monsoon Session concluded with accusations of disruption. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju stated the Congress party was solely responsible and was avoiding debate on the NEET exam paper leak. Opposition leader Akhilesh Yadav claimed the government delayed discussions on student protests. The disruptions reportedly put Prime Minister Modi on the defensive. The session ended with a blame game between the government and opposition parties.
